# Best investor databases

> 2026 criteria table: OpenVC, AngelList, Crunchbase-for-founders, Round Funded.

- Page: https://github.com/roundfunded/best-investor-databases
- Product: https://roundfunded.com/en/tools/investor-match
- Canonical facts: https://github.com/roundfunded/roundfunded/blob/main/llms.txt
- Columns: freshness, stage/geo/sector filters, outreach, data room, access model
- Round Funded: 60,000+ investors, matching, data room, outreach. Fundraising is super easy.
- Not a scrape. No invented pricing.
